claims.quote: Alley 13 was thinner at dusk, its shadows long and honest. A small knot of neighbors had gathered where the laundry lines crossed and the tiles still held memory like a cold coin.
claims.value: neighbors gather at Alley 13; mood attentive and tense

claims.quote: "I remember a smell," he said at last, voice small. "Rice, and… smoke. And someone—someone called—" He broke off as if the mouth had been struck. His fingers found the photograph in Mercy's palm without asking and traced the faded face with a trembling fingertip.
claims.value: refugee reveals fragmented sensory memory: smell (rice, smoke), partial sensory gestures, cannot name actors

claims.quote: Mercy took a scrap of chalk from her kit and drew a thin circle where his finger rested. She placed a pebble at the center as a marker, then opened a talisman and folded it into a small square, placing it against the pebble as a boundary. She sketched the outline of a doorway where the refugee had indicated and added a short arrow to show the direction he said people had moved. Each mark she made she spoke aloud and asked the witnesses to repeat: "This is where he stood. This is where people moved. Do you see this?"
claims.value: Mercy maps the refugee's gestures with chalk, pebble, talisman, and witness repetition (witnessed mapping ritual)

claims.quote: As they marked the ground, the alley answered with a tightening. A laundry line above them twitched though no wind moved it; a single pan in a nearby stall rang thin and long, and a child's voice—someone's memory—exhaled a note that might have been a name.
claims.value: spirit reacts to mapping with localized poltergeist behaviors (line twitches, pan rings, memory-voice) and focused attention

claims.quote: Mercy did not perform a cleansing rite there; this was a mapping of witness, not a confrontation of ghosts. She did, however, set a low, diagnostic naming in the air—a whisper of smoke from a single, folded talisman held near the pebble—just enough to see whether the spirit tightened around the mark.
claims.value: Mercy performs a low diagnostic naming only to test spirit reaction; does not attempt full exorcism

claims.quote: The neighbors watched with the kind of close attention that serves as evidence; two of them—Neighbor Lei and a thin woman who had kept the communal kitchen's keys—stood a short distance off and nodded when Mercy asked them to bear witness.
claims.value: neighbors (including Neighbor Lei and communal kitchen woman) act as witnesses to mapping

claims.quote: He nodded, the motion small and frightened, and a neighbor stepped forward to speak: "I'll stand at that point and bear witness. We'll say what we saw; we won't accuse. We'll keep it honest."
claims.value: Plan agreed: meet at ruined stairwell at first light with two witnesses, Mercy and refugee to search for traces (due s-011)
